attempts.summary: Configured a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster (node1/node2/node3, RHEL9, MariaDB 10.5 + galera 26.4) with wsrep replication over the private cluster network. Verified multi-master write visibility across all members, verified continued availability and automatic resync when a member is taken down and brought back, and completed the mandatory one-at-a-time node restart protocol on all three nodes with proof of changed boot identity and full cluster/data recovery after each restart.
